name: R 时间趋势线性与非线性竞争检验
purpose: 检验 Codex 提出的稳定线性趋势解释，是否被同一起点、时间顺序留出的非线性趋势模型明显反驳。
eligibility_checks: Rscript and local mgcv package are available
at least 15 complete rows and 15 distinct time points
time points are unique or were explicitly aggregated upstream
assumptions: the ordered holdout is relevant to the decision horizon
the linear and smooth time shapes are meaningful competitors
the paired circular-block holdout bootstrap preserves only short local dependence and is a screening uncertainty estimate
human_gates: confirm time and value units before interpretation
confirm that a time-shape comparison directly tests the stated E0/E1 explanations
inspect omitted drivers and regime changes before adopting a mechanism
outputs: paired loss difference with bootstrap interval
diagnostics: model fit and finite prediction status
allowed_claims: one declared time-shape model predicted the held-out tail better under the recorded fixture and uncertainty screen
the observed series is or is not consistent with a stable linear trend
forbidden_claims: time shape identifies a causal mechanism
a smooth fit proves a business turning point
the selected model can be extrapolated without a new validation horizon
